Spread out the same artist
Try to separate songs by the same artist within a round. A single-artist queue still plays every song; missing artist tags use ordinary shuffle.
Avoid recently played songs
Avoid the previous songs as well as the current song. In small queues, relax the oldest exclusions first so playback can continue.

How these rules work
Rounds, repeats, Play Next, and when changes apply
Rounds and repeat
Equal chances

With recent-song avoidance off, every song except the current one has an equal chance. With avoidance on, the remaining eligible songs have an equal chance. A queue containing only one distinct song follows the repeat setting.
Play Next stays first
Songs you add with Play Next keep their order and are not shuffled. Afterward, the original queue resumes. Single-song repeat stays unchanged.
When changes apply
Restore recommended settings
Pseudo-random, artist spacing on, and a 5-song avoidance window for pure random. Your queue stays intact.

With avoidance off, A can return before every song has played.
Recent songs are held back first. The actual order depends on the queue and avoidance window.
